predecessor_plan.revision_reason: A bounded preflight after v4 proved that rewriting job_id alone would keep invalid legacy identity live: only 86 of 769 Session-log job rows carry a canonical TraceID, 321 reuse job_id as trace_id, and 506 of 507 prompt-receipt job rows reuse job_id as trace_id. These write-only observation artifacts have no runtime reader. v5 therefore atomically archives all three complete legacy observation artifacts after writer stop and starts fresh canonical task_id streams. This preserves bytes, avoids inventing TraceID repairs outside Step09, and avoids rewriting 1.337GB over USB2. No safety, security, authentication, policy, state-migration, or runtime check is removed or weakened.

input.root_task_rule: one accepted Turn creates one durable root Task whose TaskID is the already assigned RootTaskID; no second top-level TaskID or legacy JobID is generated
input.child_task_rule: delegation of executable work from Mio to another actual CORE Agent creates one durable child Task with ParentTaskID equal to RootTaskID; Coder model provider controller and worker mechanism never become the assignee actor
input.event_rule: routing.decision is attached to the root Task; agent.assignment is attached to the selected execution Task and causally references the effective routing Event; Task records retain both EventIDs
input.event_sequence_owner: canonical Event Store assigns a positive monotonic EventSeq before monitor and SSE projection and preserves it across restart
input.historical_event_mapping_rule: for each legacy payload pair of canonical envelope TraceID and non-empty job_id, reuse the conversation receipt root_task_id when that trace has one unambiguous root; otherwise derive a deterministic TaskID from the exact trace_id plus legacy job_id; never infer across traces
input.historical_execution_report_mapping_rule: reuse the unique Event migration TaskID for the exact legacy job_id; block if one legacy job_id maps to multiple TaskIDs; when no Event mapping exists derive a deterministic TaskID from the exact namespace execution_report plus legacy job_id; reject duplicate report job IDs and preserve source row order and every non-identity field
input.historical_resilience_mapping_rule: for every incident with a non-empty repair_job_id, require one exact matching legacy execution report row and reuse that row's migrated TaskID as repair_task_id; block missing or ambiguous correlation, preserve all non-identity incident fields and every other regular file byte-for-byte, and reject symlinks or unsupported filesystem entries
input.observation_log_rotation_rule: session-log root, prompt-receipt JSONL, and LLM prompt-debug JSONL are write-only observation history with no active runtime reader; after every writer is stopped, atomically rename each exact active artifact to a timestamped owner-only legacy archive on the same filesystem, record path size mode and SHA256 in the cutover receipt, start fresh active artifacts with canonical task_id writers, and never expose archived job_id files through active paths or compatibility readers
